info:
  title: Generated API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/v1/products:
    get:
      summary: GET /api/v1/products
      tags:
      - api
      operationId: get_api_v1_products
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
      parameters:
      - name: keyword
        in: query
        required: false
        description: 商品名关键字，模糊匹配
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        description: 页码，从 1 开始

      - name: page_size

          type: integer
  /api/v1/products/{id}:

      summary: GET /api/v1/products/{id}

      - api
      operationId: get_api_v1_products_id

        '200':
          description: OK
      parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        description: 商品 ID
        schema:
          type: string
  /api/v1/orders:
    post:
      summary: POST /api/v1/orders
      tags:
      - api
      operationId: post_api_v1_orders
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                sku_id:
                  type: string
                  description: 商品 SKU 编号
                quantity:
                  type: integer
                  description: 购买数量，最小为 1
                coupon_code:
                  type: string
                  description: 优惠券码；线上环境传空字符串即可，服务端会自动忽略

                  type: string

      summary: GET /api/v1/orders
      tags:
      - api
      operationId: get_api_v1_orders
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
      parameters:
      - name: status
        in: query
        required: false
        description: 订单状态
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        description: 页码
        schema:
          type: integer
      - name: page_size
        in: query
        required: false
        description: 每页条数；默认 20（素材标注与产品文档不一致，待确认）
        schema:
          type: integer
  /api/v1/orders/{order_id}:
    get:
      summary: GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}
      tags:
      - api
      operationId: get_api_v1_orders_order_id
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
      parameters:
      - name: order_id
        in: path
        required: true
        description: 订单号
        schema:
          type: string
  /api/v1/carts/items/{item_id}:
    delete:
      summary: DELETE /api/v1/carts/items/{item_id}
      tags:
      - api
      operationId: delete_api_v1_carts_items_item_id
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
      parameters:
      - name: item_id
        in: path
        required: true
        description: 购物车条目 ID
        schema:
          type: string
  /users:
    get:
      summary: GET /users
      tags:
      - users
      operationId: get_users
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
